summary: Quashment vs compounding; Section 307 IPC invocation; distinction under Section 482 Cr.P.C.; settled disputes with civil overtones may be quashed despite non-compoundable charges; end of justice, futility of proceedings, amicable settlement considered; Gian Singh and Laxmi Narayan principles applied; public interest vs private settlement balance; case remanded for reconsideration.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order set aside; matter remanded to High Court for fresh consideration consistent with principles laid down.
